content.title: The Gospel Worthy of All Acceptation (1785)
content.author: Andrew Fuller
content.note: The book that taught Particular Baptists to offer the gospel freely to all and to call every hearer to faith, and so stands behind William Carey's mission. For the Baptist answer to hyper-Calvinism and the duty of faith. Public domain: may be quoted, with the translator or edition named and an exact locator.
